approval_note: Blind draft made without hearing the audio. Needs a human listen-through, real caption text and recorded approval before the status changes. Do not publish automatically.

segments.note: Opening beat. Trim drops a 0.43 s sound at the clip head (unknown: could be a word, breath or click) and the silent tail.
Punch-in 1.08 to disguise same-framing jump cut from c01. Blink near 3.0 s is mid-segment, not on a cut.
Back to 1.0. Trimmed to the detected speech window plus padding.
Sound starts at 0.0 s, so no head trim (a blink is visible on the first frame). Natively a little tighter; 1.06 keeps the alternation readable.
Closing beat: ends on the closed-lip smile at about 3 s, then cuts to the end card.

human_must_supply: Listen-through or transcript of c01-c09: language, topic, and whether the clips are sequential parts of one script or alternate takes
Verified Georgian caption text for each of the 11 placeholder slots (max 7 words each), and corrected caption timings
Hook title text for the single overlay, or a decision to delete the overlay
What the small round object in her hand is, and whether it may be shown or named
Presenter filming consent/release and approval to show the logo wall
Confirmation that every spoken statement is free of guaranteed-result, zero-risk, medical-advice, review or before/after claims; cut any segment that is not
Whether the sound in the first 0.43 s of c01 and the first 0.5 s of c02 is speech that must be kept
notes: All caption and overlay text is placeholder; nothing here transcribes or paraphrases speech. Trim points come from sheet frames plus ffmpeg silencedetect (-35 dB, 0.25 s), which measures level only. Extra keys (timeline_*, note, placeholder, covers, human_must_supply) are ignored by render.py.
